name: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve (OSDI 2024)
notes: Introduced chunked prefill and stall-free scheduling. Key results: 2.6x higher serving capacity for Mistral-7B on single A100, up to 3.7x for Yi-34B on two A100s, up to 5.6x for Falcon-180B with pipeline parallelism. The arXiv HTML was fetched and verified.
